extName.message: Dynamoi Release Lookup: ISRC, UPC & Label

extDescription.message: Free Dynamoi tool for artists: see the ISRC or UPC, label, release date and store links for any Spotify album or track.

commandToggle.message: Show or hide the release card

copyFailed.message: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.

noLinks.message: No other store links found yet.

notFoundBody.message: New releases usually appear within a day. Check back tomorrow.

limitedBody.message: Free lookups are busy right now. Try again later.

unavailableBody.message: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes.

offlineBody.message: Reconnect to the internet to look up this release.

ratePrompt.message: Finding Dynamoi useful? A quick rating helps other artists find it.

popupInvalid.message: Paste an album or track link from open.spotify.com, a UPC or an ISRC.

popupEmptyHistory.message: Your last 20 lookups appear here. They stay on this device.

shortcutHint.message: $VALUE$ shows or hides the card on Spotify

welcomeTitle.message: Release details for any album or track

welcomeBody.message: Dynamoi shows the ISRC or UPC, label, release date, credited artists and links to other stores for the music you open on Spotify. Free, with no account.

welcomeOpenBody.message: Go to open.spotify.com and open any album or track. The card appears in the top-right corner.

welcomePinBody.message: Click the puzzle icon in Chrome's toolbar, then the pin next to Dynamoi. The popup looks up any Spotify link, UPC or ISRC you paste.

welcomeShortcutBody.message: Press $VALUE$ on a Spotify page to show or hide the card.

welcomePrivacyBody.message: Dynamoi receives only the Spotify ID of the album or track you open, or the code you paste, to look up its release data. No account, no tracking. Your recent lookups stay on this device.
